ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on iOS and Android, with a walk recording, open an area's card on Explore, then Suggest a walk, and take a photo with the planner's camera; tap Use Photo (iOS) or the tick (Android); then the same from the outing page; make a change and press Android Back. **Expect:** the media editor opens by itself as the camera closes, as a Modal of its own over the planner, on Crop; Back goes through the editor's Close (it asks "Discard these edits?") and the planner stays open beneath; Close keeps the photo as taken. Never run on a phone (fix planner-edit, decision 0240's addendum).
